## Which package for which system

* **Ubuntu, x86_64 (.deb)** - every Ubuntu release (the install script picks this build for Ubuntu 18.04 and later and falls back to it for older ones); it also installs on other Debian-family distributions.
* **Debian, x86_64 (.deb)** - every Debian release - the install script picks this build for Debian whatever the version (it is built on Debian 9).
* **Ubuntu, ARM64 / aarch64 (.deb)** - Ubuntu 22.04 and later on ARM64 (the install script refuses older Ubuntu on ARM); published since 6.5.1.
* **RHEL-family and SUSE, x86_64 (.rpm)** - RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, AlmaLinux, Oracle Linux, Amazon Linux, SLES and openSUSE (the install script accepts any distribution whose ID_LIKE says rhel or centos); published since 3.3.1. There is no ARM64 rpm.
* **Windows, x64 (.msi)** - Windows Server and Windows desktops (the Store lists Windows 10 Enterprise and Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise), 64-bit Intel/AMD only. There is no Windows ARM64 build.
* **macOS, Intel (.pkg)** - macOS on Intel Macs (desktops and laptops); published since 2.9.0.
* **macOS, Apple silicon (.pkg)** - macOS on Apple silicon (M-series) Macs; published since 3.1.0.

The packages are the same for servers and desktops: one Windows MSI, one rpm, one deb per architecture, one macOS pkg per architecture. Which operating system releases ServiceNow supports is listed in [Server or desktop](README.md#server-or-desktop) on the index page.

## Change log

Agent Client Collector Framework 6.5.1: Patch release, published on the Store 2026-06-18, for the Australia, Zurich, Yokohama platform families.

**New**

- More precise error reporting: finer logging for ACC-1500, ACC-2000 and ACC-2500, specific ACC-4xxx codes with remediation for the Error Triage Dashboard, suggestions on upgrade errors, and a file-permission check after registration.
- Signed assets are verified against certificate validity at their timestamp.
- The MSI installer's scripts moved from VBScript to C# (VBScript kept as a fallback); installing now needs .NET Framework 4.6.2.
- Golden image preparation for VM templates; PAC_FILE in the single-line installer for macOS and Linux.
- Agents register to worker nodes rather than UI nodes; fewer running-process records; lighter keepalive database load; more Instance Scan checks.

**Changed**

- Updated sudoers requirements for rpm and deb upgrades; the relocation flag works in selective upgrades.

**Fixed**

- Timeouts querying the agent's local database APIs.
- Race in configuration publish when an agent moves to another MID before host data collection ends.
- macOS upgrades now keep the database and cache folders.
- Stopping the service on Linux now ends child processes; Windows applies process priority to every child.
- Checks missed while the agent was down now run; stale checks no longer show as active errors.
- Importing policies no longer deletes assets from the MID; policy calculation is time-boxed.
- Windows installer falsely detecting a servicenow user; re-registration after ICS-based upgrades.

**Security and library updates**

- OpenSSL 3.4.5, RDoc 6.6.3.1, Addressable 2.9.0, net-imap 0.4.24, zlib 3.1.2.

Summarised from ServiceNow's release notes; the full text is on the [Store listing](https://store.servicenow.com/store/app/bc09636e1be06a50a85b16db234bcbd1) under Version details, Release notes.

## Installing

The instance's own install script (served at `/api/sn_agent/agents/install_agent`, Linux and macOS) downloads the right package for the host, verifies its signature, installs it and writes `acc.yml` with the MID endpoint and API key:

```bash
ACC_VERSION=6.5.1 ACC_API_KEY="<api key>" ACC_MID="wss://<mid host>:8800/ws/events" bash -c "$(curl -L https://<instance>.service-now.com/api/sn_agent/agents/install_agent)"
```

By hand, with the package downloaded from the links above:

```bash
sudo dpkg -i agent-client-collector-6.5.1-ubuntu-1804_amd64.deb      # Debian / Ubuntu (use the ARM64 or Debian file on those systems)
sudo rpm -vi agent-client-collector-6.5.1-x86_64.rpm             # RHEL-family / SUSE
sudo installer -target / -pkg agent-client-collector-6.5.1-macos_arm64.pkg   # macOS (Intel: the macos_x64 file)
```

```powershell
msiexec /i agent-client-collector-6.5.1-windows-x64.msi /qn ACC_API_KEY="<api key>" ACC_MID="wss://<mid host>:8800/ws/events"
```

After a manual Linux or macOS install, set `endpoint` and `api-key` in `acc.yml` (`/etc/servicenow/agent-client-collector/acc.yml`) and restart the `acc` service. The Windows MSI takes both as properties.
